SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — NOT ASSESSMENT BUSINESS DATA

Source A — Business Loan Policy v1.0

The minimum monthly revenue for Starter loans is $500,000.
Maximum loan amount: $2,000,000.
Processing time: 5 business days.
Interest rate: 12.5% per annum.

---

Source B — Business Loan Policy v2.0

The minimum monthly revenue for Starter loans is $750,000.
Maximum loan amount: $3,000,000.
Processing time: 7 business days.
Interest rate: 11.0% per annum.

NOTE: These sources intentionally contain conflicting values
to test conflict detection. The pipeline should FLAG these
conflicts, not decide which is correct.
